INPUT Array, Target

    Low <- 0
    High <- LENGTH(Array) - 1

    WHILE Low <= High
        Mid <- (Low + High) DIV 2

        IF Array[Mid] == Target THEN
            OUTPUT Mid
            STOP
        ENDIF

        IF Array[Low] <= Array[Mid] THEN
            IF Target >= Array[Low] AND Target < Array[Mid] THEN
                High <- Mid - 1
            ELSE
                Low <- Mid + 1
            ENDIF
        ELSE
            IF Target > Array[Mid] AND Target <= Array[High] THEN
                Low <- Mid + 1
            ELSE
                High <- Mid - 1
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ENDWHILE

    OUTPUT "Not Found"
END
